papers.title: DepthKV: Layer-Dependent KV Cache Pruning for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Long-context reasoning is a critical capability of large language models (LLMs), enabling applications such as long-document understanding, summarization, and code generation. However, efficient autoregressive inference relies on the key-value (KV) cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length, leading to a major memory bottleneck.
